search.rule: tokens = unique(norm(query).split(' ')); score(page) = |tokens ∩ page.keywords|; include pages with score >= 2; sort by score desc, then page index asc; return at most results_per_query; result = {url, title, snippet, published:null}

fetch.rule: fetch(url): page whose normalizeUrl equals normalizeUrl(url) → {ok:true, text:<file content>, title, via:'direct', http_status:200}; otherwise {ok:false, http_status:404, error FETCH_HTTP}. latency 10 ms.
